text: Northstar is a fictional company. Revenue for 2025 was 148 million USD, compared with 120 million USD in 2024. Subscription revenue was 102 million USD. These figures are synthetic.
Northstar depends on two cloud providers. Service interruptions could delay customer onboarding. The five largest customers accounted for 31 percent of revenue in 2025.
Northstar reported operating cash flow of 24 million USD in 2025. Capital expenditure was 9 million USD. The board did not declare a dividend.
Northstar revenue was 120 million USD in 2024. Subscription revenue was 79 million USD. This is a fictional disclosure, not a statement by a real issuer.
Cedar is a fictional company. Revenue for 2025 was 86 million USD, compared with 81 million USD in 2024. Hardware revenue was 62 million USD.
Cedar purchases specialized components from one supplier. A supply disruption could delay hardware deliveries. Its largest customer accounted for 18 percent of revenue.
Cedar generated operating cash flow of 11 million USD in 2025. Capital expenditure was 7 million USD. Cedar did not provide an earnings forecast.
Cedar revenue was 81 million USD in 2024. Hardware revenue was 57 million USD. All figures in this example are invented for software testing.
